name: Trapmaster Tok's Surprise (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
description: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling
disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

generalAbilities.name: Falling Debris
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Pressure is placed on any floor tile

Effect The barrel of debris tips over and showers broken glass down. The glass deals 2d8 Slashing Damage damage and 1 Bleed Damage damage(Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save) to all creatures within 10 feet.
